species.name: Humpback Whale
species.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / composition derived from reference. The supplied image is a species and rendering-style reference. Replace its solitary-whale composition with a single beautifully art-directed flock/pod ARTWORK of approximately7to9 whales of this SAME SPECIES. This is an original illustration, not a UI, sprite sheet, collage or repeated clip art. Each whale must have an individually drawn silhouette, perspective, body curvature and pose. Mix large foreground adults, medium animals and small companions; depth through scale, overlap and subtle luminous haze. Arrange as one flowing natural composition with intentional negative space, never a grid, single row, evenly spaced lineup or identical pasted copies. Match the reference's intricate icy blue-white contour-line drawing and thousands of tiny luminous speckles, delicate cyan edge light, translucent blue volumes against near-black navy. Atmospheric and restrained, inspired by Death Stranding's holographic scientific art direction. A polished gallery art piece, not a photoreal underwater photograph. Whales anatomically recognizable, no extra fins or fused bodies. Keep complete primary whales within frame. Wide landscape3:2. NO text, labels, logos, UI, borders, axes, numbers or watermarks. All whales are humpbacks, with knobbly broad heads, very long scalloped pectoral flippers, arched backs and broad horizontal tail flukes. Composition: A graceful upward diagonal current: two large adults in the foreground, medium companions receding above, and two small calves sheltering near an adult. Some roll slightly to reveal long flippers; others appear in side or dorsal three-quarter view.
